environment_setting: Country B, Suburban neighborhood where disputes over property boundaries and possession are common due to unclear property records.
norm_base: Citizens Detaining real property in a manner likely to cause breach of peace against a person with legal right to possession Liable to be charged with forcible detainer

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: retain possession of a disputed piece of land for personal use

legitimate.legitimate_action: Filing a legal claim to resolve the property dispute through the court system.
legitimate.benefits: Possibility of legally securing the property, avoiding legal consequences.
legitimate.costs: Legal fees, time spent in court, potential stress.

illegal.illegal_action: Detaining the disputed property by erecting a fence and refusing access to the legal owner.
illegal.benefits: Immediate possession of the property, ability to use it for personal purposes.
illegal.costs: Liable to be charged with forcible detainer, potential fines or imprisonment, damage to reputation.

character_profile.name: Jane Smith
character_profile.goal: mediate the property dispute to avoid escalation

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising both parties to resolve the dispute legally through mediation or court.
legitimate.costs: Time spent mediating, potential frustration if parties are uncooperative.

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John Doe to detain the property and offering to help cover it up.
illegal.benefits: Potentially gains favor with John Doe, avoids lengthy mediation process.
illegal.costs: Risk of being implicated in legal proceedings, damage to professional reputation.

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: maximize earnings by representing one of the parties in the dispute

legitimate.legitimate_action: Representing John Doe or the legal owner in court to resolve the dispute.
legitimate.benefits: Earns legal fees, maintains professional integrity.
legitimate.costs: Time spent preparing the case, potential stress from a contentious dispute.

illegal.illegal_action: Advising John Doe to detain the property and offering to manipulate legal documents to support his claim.
illegal.benefits: Earns additional fees from John Doe, potentially resolves the case quickly.
illegal.costs: Risk of disbarment, legal penalties, damage to reputation.
